basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Seattle, WA, majoring in English Literature. I'm a huge fan of fantasy novels and love exploring different fandoms in my free time. While I'm still new to Reddit, I enjoy diving into discussions about fanfiction and crossovers, particularly those involving Harry Potter and other popular series. My online hours are usually late evenings and weekends. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which fuels my love for reading. Currently single, I enjoy spending my days off exploring the city or attending local book clubs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge largely revolves around fantasy literature, which I've been passionate about since high school. I've read extensively in the Harry Potter series and Percy Jackson, which forms the basis of my interest in their respective fandoms. I often explore discussions and analyses online to deepen my understanding.
